title: Powers of the specified rational compact-support Frobenius
statement:
Fix the global finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], with $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$. Let $X_0$ be separated of finite type over $k_0$, put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, and let $K_{\mathcal O}\in D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$ have reductions in $D^b_{ctf}(X,A_n)$ for $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n$. Let $K_E$ be its rationalization [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], and let $\varphi_E:Lg_\gamma^*K_E\to K_E$ be any morphism. Use exactly the rationalized pullbacks, compact-support functor, composition identifications and direct base-change transports $B_{m,M}:R\Gamma_c(X,M)\to R\Gamma_c(X,L(g_\gamma^m)^*M)$ specified in [prop-trf-rational-frobenius-integral-model], not independently chosen isomorphisms. Write $G=Lg_\gamma^*$ and identify $G^m$ with $L(g_\gamma^m)^*$ by those composition maps. Then $B_{1,-}:R\Gamma_c\Rightarrow R\Gamma_c\circ G$ is natural for rational morphisms and
$$B_{m+1,M}=B_{1,G^mM}\circ B_{m,M}\qquad(m\ge1).$$
For the iterates $\varphi_E^{[m]}=\varphi_E\circ G(\varphi_E)\circ\cdots\circ G^{m-1}(\varphi_E)$, the specified global operators satisfy
$$F_{c,K_E}^{\,m}=R\Gamma_c(X,\varphi_E^{[m]})\circ B_{m,K_E}=(F_{c,K_E}^{\,1})^m\qquad(m\ge1).$$
No invertibility or integral Weil structure on $\varphi_E$ is required.
